column1: # vdi-raster32.tsv -- NewTOS contract (ADR-038), 32-plane setting: no oracle.
# The memory-form raster group at vdiplanes=32 (TASK/V69). A WIDE table
# (tosdump/core/cases.h, "THE 32-PLANE SETTING"): it declares a 32-plane
# screen, so DUMPRAST runs it only at 32 planes, writes the wide record
# (area 7 VDI-RASTER32, 5744 bytes, buffers of 1024 WORDs) and logs "NewTOS
# contract (ADR-038), no oracle". EmuTOS has no path above 16 planes
# (vdi_defs.h:22): nothing here is compared with an oracle. The values a
# case must show are the contract's -- ADR-038 (docs/MEMORY.md) and the
# 32-plane sections of docs/api/vdi/raster/_raster.md (V63 R1-R6, V64
# P1-P9, V65 sections 2-6) -- and tosdump/host/contract32-check.py lays
# them beside every case, computed from the case line itself; its dump is
# a regression baseline (NEWTOS32-...), never an expectation by itself.
# Run: cargo xtask tosdump rast tosdump/cases/vdi-raster32.tsv --out <dir>
#      --bootargs vdiplanes=32
#   opcode <TAB> intin <TAB> ptsin <TAB> src <TAB> dst <TAB> fill <TAB> comment
# src/dst = buffer,fd_w,fd_h,fd_wdwidth,fd_stand,fd_nplanes (buffer 0 = A,
# 1 = B); fill = the two seeds of td_rast_fill (tosdump/core/record.c).
# THE 32-PLANE MEMORY FORM (V65 section 3): fd_stand 0, fd_nplanes 32, one
# native-endian 32-bit pixel 0xXXRRGGBB per position, row fd_wdwidth * 16
# pixels. On AArch64 the WORD array holds pixel k as WORD 2k (low) and
# 2k+1 (high). A 32 x 16 form (fd_wdwidth 2) is 1024 WORDs, the whole wide
# buffer. Memory-to-memory results are exact in all 32 bits, X included:
# every pixel here comes from the buffers' fill or a pen, none from a
# screen pixel no pen wrote.
# Planar 1..8-plane forms are depth-independent (V65 section 2) and are
# measured by vdi-raster.tsv at 32 against its own 16-plane run; they are
# not restated here.
!screen
# SECTION M -- vro_cpyfm (109) 32-plane memory to memory.
# The 16/16 group of vdi-raster.tsv, restated at 32 planes. The 16 logic
# ops act bitwise on all 32 bits (V63 R4, V65 section 3): ALL_WHITE writes
# 0x00000000, ALL_BLACK 0xFFFFFFFF, D_ONLY changes nothing. The source
# rectangle is sorted (arb_corner), the destination extent is the source's
# (dont_clip), an overlap inside one buffer reads every source pixel before
# it is overwritten (the start-address rule, vdi_raster.c:995-1002).

column7: M1 op 0 ALL_WHITE: 0x00000000
M2 op 1 S_AND_D
M3 op 2 S_AND_NOTD
M4 op 3 S_ONLY: the source pixels, all 32 bits
M5 op 4 NOTS_AND_D
M6 op 5 D_ONLY: nothing changes
M7 op 6 S_XOR_D
M8 op 7 S_OR_D
M9 op 8 NOT_SORD
M10 op 9 NOT_SXORD
M11 op 10 NOT_D: X complemented too
M12 op 11 S_OR_NOTD
M13 op 12 NOT_S
M14 op 13 NOTS_OR_D
M15 op 14 NOT_SANDD
M16 op 15 ALL_BLACK: 0xFFFFFFFF
M17 PAT_FLAG|3 on the truecolor path: nothing copied
M18 one pixel, a degenerate rectangle
M19 reversed source corners: arb_corner sorts
M20 reversed destination corners
M21 a rectangle at the far corner of the form
M22 the whole form: B = A, 1024 WORDs
M23 PTSIN[6..7] too big: the extent is the source's
M24 overlap in A, destination down and right
M25 overlap in A, destination up and left
M26 XOR inside one buffer, no overlap
M27 overlap in A, right by 3 on the same rows
M28 overlap in A, up and left by 3,4

column1: # SECTION R -- the refusals at 32 (V65 section 2; ADR-038 point 5, O5).
# A refused call is a silent no-op: destination, INTOUT, PTSOUT and the
# MFDBs (fd_stand included) untouched, both buffers keep their fill.
# A 9..31-plane memory form is refused at 32 -- 16 planes included -- and
# so is a plane mismatch (s_nxwd != d_nxwd) and an invalid mode.

column7: R1 16-plane memory forms: refused at 32 (O5)
R2 12-plane memory forms: refused
R3 9-plane memory forms: refused
R4 31-plane memory forms: refused
R5 32 to 16 planes: mismatch, refused
R6 16 to 32 planes: mismatch, refused
R7 mode above bit 5 is invalid
R8 mode 0x7FFF invalid
R9 no intin at all: INTIN[0] is the poison
R10 vrt_cpyfm 1 to 16 planes: refused at 32
R11 vrt_cpyfm 1 to 12 planes: refused
R12 vrt_cpyfm 1 to 9 planes: refused
R13 vrt_cpyfm source 32 planes, not mono: no-op
R14 vr_trnfm 16-plane source at 32: no-op (V65 section 5, inferred)
R15 vr_trnfm 12 planes in place at 32: no-op, fd_stand kept

column1: # SECTION V -- vrt_cpyfm (121) mono into a 32-plane memory form.
# Source buffer A as a 1-plane 32x16 form (MSB first). Colours INTIN[1]
# and [2] through validate_color_index (ncol 256 at 32), then the pen's
# pixel 0x00RRGGBB, each gun q = (c * 255 + 500) / 1000 (V64 P2, P3):
# 00BBBBBB, 9 00888888, 16 00FFFFFF, 255 00000000. MD_REPLACE fg/bg,
# MD_TRANS fg on set bits, MD_XOR the complement of all 32 bits on set
# bits, MD_ERASE bg on clear bits (V65 section 4).

column7: V1 MD_REPLACE pens 1/0: set 0x00000000, clear 0x00FFFFFF
V2 MD_TRANS pen 2: set 0x00FF0000, clear keeps the fill
V3 MD_XOR: set ~fill (32 bits), clear the fill
V4 MD_ERASE bg pen 6: clear 0x00FFFF00, set keeps the fill
V5 MD_REPLACE red/blue
V6 MD_REPLACE pens 8/9: 0x00BBBBBB / 0x00888888
V7 pens out of range: validate_color_index -> 1
V8 pens 255/16 (videl_palette2): 0x00000000 / 0x00FFFFFF
V9 8x8 to (3,5): fill outside
V10 source at (5,3), not word aligned
V11 PAT_FLAG|MD_REPLACE on the truecolor path: nothing
V12 mode 0 is not an MD_ code: no-op
V13 mode 5 is not an MD_ code: no-op

column1: # SECTION T -- vr_trnfm (110) at 32 planes (V65 section 5).
# planesize = fd_h * fd_wdwidth WORDs per plane (the source's); plane p
# holds bit 31 - p of the pixel, the leftmost pixel the MSB of each WORD;
# planes 0..7 are X, 8..15 R, 16..23 G, 24..31 B. Output zero-filled, in
# place through a scratch, planesize * 32 WORDs; the destination's fd_stand
# is NOT written. A 16x16 form is 512 WORDs, a 32x16 form 1024.

column7: T1 standard to device, 16x16
T2 device to standard, 16x16
T3 standard to device, 32x16: the whole buffer
T4 device to standard, 32x16
T5 in place, standard to device
T6 in place, device to standard
T7 destination already says standard: fd_stand not written
T8 in place, one row, device to standard
